resources.string: Optional. Off by default. Uses your own Anthropic API key.

Garmin\'s developer terms reportedly bar using Garmin data to \"create or maintain any AI model, AI system or AI generated knowledge base\". The coach is optional and off by default. If you turn it on, Stride sends only numbers it has already computed (training load, fitness, fatigue and form, heart-rate zone minutes, VDOT, efficiency and weekly volume) to Anthropic, using your own API key. It never sends GPS, streams, laps, FIT files or raw Garmin data, and nothing is used to train a model. Decide for yourself whether this fits Garmin\'s terms.
I have read this and want to use the coach
Create one at console.anthropic.com. It is stored encrypted on this phone.
Turn off coach and delete key
Sync some runs (or try the demo) and ask again.
Only these computed numbers go to Anthropic.
